final: WITH j AS (SELECT m.link_to_major AS link_to_major, mj.college AS college, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id GROUP BY m.link_to_major, mj.college), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS s FROM j), sh AS (SELECT j.link_to_major, j.college, j.cnt, CAST(j.cnt AS REAL) / tot.s AS share FROM j, tot WHERE tot.s IS NOT NULL), ca AS (SELECT college, AVG(share) AS college_avg FROM sh GROUP BY college HAVING AVG(share) IS NOT NULL) SELECT sh.link_to_major, sh.college, sh.cnt, sh.share, sh.share - ca.college_avg AS diff FROM sh JOIN ca ON sh.college = ca.college WHERE sh.share > ca.college_avg ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
